title: Kenyan court halts construction of US-backed Ebola centre
summary: A Kenyan court has ordered the government to stop building a facility for treating suspected Ebola cases. The decision follows an order issued by Kenya's Health Minister.
summary_points: The Kenyan High Court ruled that the Ruto administration must halt construction of the US-backed centre.
title_hi: Kenya ki mahakama ne US ke saath Ebola kendra ka nirman rukwa diya
summary_hi: Ek Kenya ki mahakonee rasm se sabit ho gaya hai ki Ruto sarkar ko ye facility banane mein rokna chahiye. Ye faisla Kenya Health Minister dwara diye gaye hukm ke baad aaya.
summary_points_hi: Kenya High Court ne Ruto administration par yeh niyamit kar diya ki wo US-supported centre ka nirman rukwa de.

sources.headline: Kenyan Court Forces Ruto Govt To Halt Construction of US Ebola Centre | Firstpost Africa
